_README: OPTIONAL overrides for the per-project cost report.
cc-usage ships Anthropic's first-party API list prices (see BUILTIN_PRICES in
app/src/projects.rs, dated BUILTIN_PRICES_AS_OF). You only need this file to
override an entry (newer prices, another provider's rate card) or to add a
model the built-in table does not know.
To use it, copy it to pricing.json in the data folder (%LOCALAPPDATA%\cc-usage,
or CC_USAGE_DATA_DIR) and keep only the models you want to override; an
entry here replaces the built-in one for that model. The zeros below are
Unit: dollars per million tokens. cache_write and cache_read are optional;
when omitted, the input price is used as an approximation (never zero).
Model names must match the transcripts; a dated id such as
claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 also matches an entry named claude-haiku-4-5.
